items.t: Jim Cramer Says Rocket Lab Has ‘Gotten Too Cheap’ Just After Its Electron Rocket Hit 100 Launches Faster Than Any Other Commercial Rocket
items.sum: Jim Cramer has flipped on Rocket Lab before, and now he sees a bargain after a five-day slide. But he attaches a one-word warning to the call, and the company's own numbers show why.
